_comment: Toolchain inventory for the baseline build. Every entry records what the
pipeline needs, whether its redistribution is permitted, and how the
pipeline should locate it. tools/buusfury/toolchain.py turns this into a
machine-readable doctor report. Nothing here is ever committed as a binary.

redistribution_policy.ads12: PROHIBITED. ARM Developer Suite 1.2 is commercial software. It is installed locally by the operator and located through ADS12_ROOT. Binaries and licence files are gitignored and must never be committed or shipped.
redistribution_policy.grit: Permitted. Open source (GBA Raster Image Transmogrifier); redistributed by devkitPro. Not vendored here - located on PATH.
redistribution_policy.jcalg1: Permitted for this use. Jeremy Collake's JCALG1 ships its own LICENSE in the upstream submodule (tools/compress/jcalg1/LICENSE). Fetched with the reference checkout, never vendored here.
redistribution_policy.msvc: Permitted for local use. Used only to build the JCALG1 compression front-end.

tools.purpose: Assemble asm/crt0.s, asm/GBARam.s, asm/buu.s and the INCBIN directives that place asset blobs.
Link with -noremove -scatter scatter.ld. -noremove is load-bearing: without it armlink discards the SPACE-reserved EWRAM/IWRAM sections.
Convert the linked ELF to a raw binary (fromelf <axf> -bin -o build/output).
ARM C compiler. Not invoked by the reference build script, but named in its README and implied by the original toolchain. Recorded for DECOMP-COMPILER-PROBE-001.

ARM C preprocessor / Thumb C compiler driver. DIRECT EVIDENCE OF THE ORIGINAL BUILD: asm/GBARam.s line 5 preserves the original command line 'tcpp -S -c -cpu ARM7TDMI -O1 src/GBARam.c'. That is the only surviving statement of the original optimisation level.
Convert the source BMPs to raw GBA 8bpp image data.

tools.note: MUST be a CMake that can name a Visual Studio generator. The MSYS2/MinGW cmake shipped by devkitPro CANNOT: it fails with 'Could not create named generator Visual Studio 17 2022'. Verified working: the CMake bundled with Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools.

tools.purpose: Build the JCALG1 compression front-end. Must be the x86 (32-bit) toolchain: jcalg1_static.lib is a prebuilt 32-bit library.
Run the region-map, identity, build and verification harness.
